## Code Review: Prevent Duplicate Fragment Title on Clone (Issue #11)

### Executive Summary

The implementation is complete and functionally correct. `generateUniqueTitle` in `utils.js` correctly strips trailing numeric suffixes and iterates upward to find a free title. Pre-population of `titleClone` was added to both `editor-panel.js` and `mas-fragment-editor.js`. The `copyFragment` method in `mas-repository.js` correctly resolves the effective title and collects existing titles scoped to the same folder — **however**, the exact-folder-match fix (`split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/') === folderPath`) is present only in the **working tree** and has not been committed; the committed HEAD still uses the over-broad `startsWith(folderPath)`. All `node --check` validations pass.

---

### Issues by Severity

#### Tech Debt

**1. Uncommitted folder-path fix in `mas-repository.js`**
- **Location**: `studio/src/mas-repository.js:1019` (working tree vs HEAD)
- **Description**: The committed HEAD uses `s.get?.()?.path?.startsWith(folderPath)` which matches fragments in subfolders and sibling paths sharing the same prefix (e.g., `/content/dam/offers` would match `/content/dam/offers-v2/card`). The working tree has the correct fix: `s.get?.()?.path?.split('/').slice(0, -1).join('/') === folderPath` (exact parent-folder equality). This fix exists but is not staged or committed.
- **Recommended fix**: Stage and commit the working-tree change in `mas-repository.js`.

---

#### Skippable

**2. Duplicate commit messages on branch**
- **Location**: commits `b71066d` and `675dbc0`
- **Description**: Both commits carry the message `feat(studio): prevent duplicate fragment title on clone`; the second additionally has errant backtick formatting (`` ` feat(studio): ... ` ``). The commit history reads confusingly.
- **Recommended fix**: Consider squashing into a single clean commit before merging.

**3. Missing isolated suffix test**
- **Location**: `studio/test/utils.test.js` — `generateUniqueTitle` suite
- **Description**: The "strips existing trailing suffix" test always includes both `'my-card-1'` and `'my-card'` in the set. There is no test for `generateUniqueTitle('my-card-1', ['my-card-1'])` without `'my-card'` present. The behavior is correct (returns `'my-card-2'`), but the isolated case is not explicitly covered.
- **Recommended fix**: Add one more test case to the suite.

---

### Plan Compliance

| Acceptance Criterion | Status |
|---|---|
| Cloning collision in same folder → `{original}-1` | ✅ `generateUniqueTitle` returns `stem-1` on first collision |
| Re-clone when `-1` exists → `{original}-2` | ✅ Counter increments past all occupied suffixes |
| No collision → title unchanged | ✅ Early-return on `!set.has(baseTitle)` |
| Original fragment title never modified | ✅ `result` is the copy; `this.fragmentInEdit` is not mutated |
| Manual title edit respected and deduplicated | ✅ `effectiveTitle = updatedTitle \|\| fragmentInEdit.title` |
| `generateUniqueTitle` pure, fully tested | ✅ 6 unit tests; no side effects |
| `node --check` passes on all four files | ✅ All four pass |
| `generateUniqueTitle` added to `utils.js` | ✅ Exported at line 381 |
| `editor-panel.js` pre-populates `titleClone` | ✅ Line 627 |
| `mas-fragment-editor.js` pre-populates `titleClone` | ✅ Line 1095 |
| `generateUniqueTitle` imported in `mas-repository.js` | ✅ Line 10 |

---

### Screenshot Validation Log

**Screenshot 01** — Purpose: Verify Studio clone dialog UI at `http://localhost:3000/studio`
- **Actual**: Authentication (IMS sign-in) wall is displayed; the Studio UI is not accessible without valid credentials.
- **Entity type match**: N/A — login screen only.
- **Verdict**: Cannot validate clone dialog visually; all validation performed via static code analysis and `node --check`.

---

### Verdict: **PASS**

No blocker issues. The core algorithm is correct, spec criteria are fully implemented, and all syntax checks pass. The uncommitted folder-matching fix (`tech_debt`) should be committed before merging, but it is over-conservative rather than under-conservative (may generate an unnecessary `-1` suffix in edge cases with subfolder fragments, but will never create duplicates).
